text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the tryouts is finally here.
While Yukino Bijin's been busy
practicing,
a surprise for her has been in the works
behind the scenes.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Yuki! Guess who's here?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: J-j-jinkies!

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text:
Yukino! We're here to cheer you on!
Long
time, no see, kiddo!
You're grow'n faster
than a beanstalk!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What are you all doing here?! You even
brought my parents! Good
golly, and
what's with that snazzy banner?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Your trainer gave us a call, and we
knew we had t'come cheer
you on.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So this was all a s'prise... Geez Louise, I
almost flipped my wig. But
you know...
Ahaha, I'm not nervous an'more! Thank
you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh, it's Yukino Bijin! She's as cute as
eveeeer! Never fear, your
faithful cheer
squad is here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Did I tell you I got a Yukino plushie? I
can't believe she's already got
merch!
She's an idol, through and through!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Wow, Yuki, you sure are popular!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-it's not like they're fans of my rac'n...
They're just... follow'n the
latest trends...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yuki... Don't say someth'n so sad! There's
noth'n wrong with being
part of a trend!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You've got lots more people cheer'n you
on now, don't you? That
means there's
plenty of people ready to watch you give
it your all!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Things like trends and luck are a part of
success too, you know! If
noth'n else,
trends are just another opportunity! One
you need to
grab onto!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trends... are an opp'rtunity?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: My life? How 'xactly do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wait, don't tell me! That's for me t'decide, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I can't believe I let m'self get all gloomy
over a trend... I should be
thank'n my
lucky stars! Now I can show ev'ryone what
I'm made of...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All righty! Friends, fam'ly, fans, Trainer...
just you watch! I'm gonna go
out there and
win this!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Next up, number nine in the popularity
rankings, Yukino Bijin! All
eyes are on this
small-town beauty!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Aw, what's the big deal? She's an idol. She doesn't have to actually win. She'll draw a crowd just being her pretty little self!

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text: Grrrrr!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You show 'em, Yuki! You're not just a
pretty face—you've got the
heart 'n' soul
of Morioka in you! Isn't that right,
ev'rybody?!

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text: Yeeeeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And they're off!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Yukino Bijin's managed to get into
a good position! Will she
take the lead?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You bet I will! No one's tak'n first place
from me! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
She still going?! Wh-whoa, she's leaving
the competition in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm not done yet! I gotta win this! I need t'win this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And I'm not stopp'n there! Someday, I'll be
shin'n 'longside all the
other stars, just as
bright as can be! Someday, I'm gonna be...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be... a REAL city girl!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin! Yukino Bijin's still in the lead!
Can anybody stop her?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Coming in hot towards the finish, Yukino Bijin's still ahead by a long shot, and—GOAAAAAL!

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Phew! I-I did it! I won!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text:
No way, she won?! Wait, are we sure that's
the same Yukino Bijin? She
seems totally
different...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The hell?! She was so fast! These
Umamusume from the sticks are wild!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehe... Hehe! Look at all their stup'fied
faces!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Yuki! That was so, so
cool! See'n you really gave me
the courage
I needed to work on my skat'n skills!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Um, you're Yuki's trainer, right? Thank you
for everyth'n you've done,
and keep up
the good work!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Father
text_block_list.text:
We could say the same thing. This girl's
the pride 'n' joy of our small
town. Please
take care of her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
M-Mifuyu, Dad, stop! Th-this pers'n... was
only act'n as my trainer for
this one race...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Holy moly! You're not pull'n my leg, are
you?! I mean, um... that'd be
a dream come
true for me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I'm gonna be the coolest cat
you've ever seen!
